purpose: Persistent registry of research candidates that showed positive executable BASE performance at some preregistered stage. Registry inclusion does not imply validation or production readiness.

status_legend.research_positive: Positive executable result observed, but strict research-survivor gate not passed.
status_legend.discovery_survivor: Passed the preregistered discovery/research gate; requires untouched confirmation.
status_legend.confirmation_failed: Previously passed discovery but failed an untouched confirmation window.
status_legend.validated: Passed untouched confirmation. None as of registry_version 1.

candidates.reason_not_promoted: Minimum trades gate missed: 29 < 30. Subsequent adaptive deployment was strongly negative.
Too few trades/days/folds and excessive winner concentration.

candidates.reason_not_promoted: Failed untouched Internal Confirmation. Preserve as a discovered but non-transferable historical pattern; never trade or retune using the retired confirmation window.
